roster_grade.headline: 10-2 and #1 in title odds. Mahomes is back, so a QB is now spare: sell Shough high for a young RB
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 composite title odds: #1 by record (10-2), tied #1 in points for (860, level with dickcole2410), #5 by roster value. That's a win-now team. Keep every producing starter and spend true surplus (the extra QB, bench WRs, Kamara, picks) on the one soft spot: an aging RB room.

strengths.label: Best record in the league
strengths.detail: 10-2 with 860 points for. Two games clear of four 8-4 teams (Rolling Ball, dickcole2410, Threat Level Midnight, Buck-ee's).

strengths.label: Spare QB with Mahomes back
strengths.detail: Mahomes and Shough are starting, with Nix and Jalon Daniels on the bench. Superflex only starts two, so one of Shough/Nix plus Daniels can be traded. QB need is 0.0.

strengths.label: Deep WR group
strengths.detail: Parker Washington, Watson, and DeVonta Smith start. Tee Higgins (3,149) is a starting-quality WR4 on the bench, and Stribling is on IR. WR need is 0.0.

strengths.label: Loveland plus extra picks
strengths.detail: Young TE1 in Loveland, Hockenson behind him, and an extra 2028 1st and 2027 2nd to deal from.

weaknesses.label: Aging RB room
weaknesses.detail: Henry (32), Javonte (26), Hubbard (27), and Kamara (31) are all Declining. RB need is 0.4, the only real need on the roster.

weaknesses.label: Hubbard is running hot
weaknesses.detail: Carolina is scoring 29.2 a game against a 22.6 Vegas average (+6.6). His production may cool off. This is the time to swap him for a younger RB, not to rely on him.

weaknesses.label: Thin RB depth
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey (1,809) is in the lineup. One more RB injury and Kamara is starting.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Sell Tyler Shough while he's running hot (+3.3 vs Vegas), now that Mahomes is starting again: Shough + Malik Washington for Jeremiyah Love (Sheldumbass, 0-12, weak at QB/RB/WR). Nix moves into the lineup. Then swap Hubbard + 2027 3rd for Kyren Williams (You Hate Us, Long shot and selling; Rams scoring 4.1 a game under Vegas). Keep Mahomes, Henry, Javonte, and every starting WR.

QB.commentary: Mahomes is back with Shough, and Nix and Daniels are on the bench. That's four QBs for two slots, with QB need 0.0. Shough is the sell-high chip and Nix can step in as the starter.

RB.commentary: Henry, Javonte, Hubbard, and Harvey all start, but every vet is Declining and Hubbard's numbers are inflated by a hot offense. This is where to upgrade (need 0.4).

WR.commentary: Three producing starters plus Higgins on the bench and Stribling on IR. Higgins is the WR you can move for an RB.

TE.commentary: Loveland is the long-term TE1 and Hockenson is quality depth. Need is just 0.05.

trade_priority_order: Shough + Malik Washington → Jeremiyah Love (Sheldumbass, 0-12, weak at QB/RB/WR). Sell Shough high now that Mahomes is starting.
Hubbard + 2027 3rd → Kyren Williams (You Hate Us, Long shot and selling). Sell high on Hubbard, buy low on Kyren.
Tee Higgins → Omarion Hampton (Quarterback Factory, 3-9, weak at WR/RB). A bench WR for a young RB, bought low (Chargers -6.6).
Jalon Daniels + 2027 2nd + Josh Cameron → Breece Hall (Bijan Mustard, 2-10)
All-in instead of Love: Shough + Javonte Williams + 2027 2nd + 2028 3rd → Bijan Robinson (Bijan Mustard)
Sell Kamara to Rolling Ball (8-4 contender, weak at RB) for a 2027 4th
Hold Mahomes, Henry, Loveland, and the starting WRs. You're 10-2.

sell_now.reason: Mahomes is back, so a QB is spare. Shough is worth more than Nix (3,891 vs 3,193), and New Orleans is scoring 3.3 a game over Vegas, so his value is at its peak. Nix takes the second QB slot.
A starter, but 27, Declining, and inflated by Carolina scoring +6.6 a game over Vegas. Swapping him for a younger RB at the same spot is an upgrade, not a sell.
QB4 who will never start for you. Rebuilders like a rookie QB, so he works as a package piece.
31-year-old bench RB whose value only drops from here.

buy_now.reason: 0-12 and weak at QB, RB, and WR. Shough gives them a starting QB and Malik Washington a WR, for one rookie RB.

buy_now.from_team: You Hate Us Cuz You Anus
buy_now.reason: Long shot, flagged as selling, and weak at RB/WR/TE. The Rams are scoring 22.5 a game against a 26.6 Vegas average, so you're buying low.
3-9 and weak at WR. The Chargers are 6.6 a game under Vegas, the biggest buy-low on the board. Your bench WR4 for their young RB.
2-10, and Hall is on their bench. Dart is on IR, so a young QB helps them.
The all-in, as an alternative to the Love deal (it also uses Shough). Mahomes, Henry, Nix, and Harvey all stay.

do_not_trade: Derrick Henry (producing starter on a 10-2 team)
Parker Washington / Christian Watson / DeVonta Smith (starting WRs)
Bo Nix (becomes the starting QB2 once Shough is traded)
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're 10-2, so picks are currency. Use 2nds through 4ths, including the extra 2027 2nd, to close gaps on RB deals. Hold the extra 2028 1st and your own 2027 1st unless they land Bijan or Love outright.

outlook.projected_power_rank: #1 composite title odds (#1 record, tied #1 PF, #5 value). You're the top seed if the lineup holds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now with the Mahomes/Loveland/WR core. Adding a young RB this season (Love, Kyren, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan) also covers 2027, when Henry and Javonte age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 10-2 in Week 6: best record, tied for most points, and #1 in title odds. Mahomes is starting again, so Shough is a spare QB at peak value. With five Long shot teams to deal with, Shough, Hubbard, Higgins, and Daniels can buy a younger RB room without weakening the lineup.
key_risks: Regression: Hubbard (+6.6) and Shough (+3.3) are on offenses scoring above their Vegas totals
An RB injury, since Harvey is already starting
Rolling Ball (8-4, weak at RB, buying) is competing with you for the same sellers' RBs
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Kyren, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan turns RB into a strength
Stribling coming back from IR deepens WR, which makes Higgins easier to move
An extra 2028 1st and 2027 2nd to spend before the deadline

teams_to_watch.why: 8-4 and tied with you for most points (860). Your main title rival, so a contender rather than a trade partner.
0-12 and weak at QB/RB/WR. Holds Jeremiyah Love, and Shough is the key to getting him.

teams_to_watch.why: 7-5 but a Long shot and flagged as selling. Holds Kyren Williams at a buy-low price.
